title: Portrait photograph of LT Delbert Clement Newhouse, USN, dated 14 January 1949
description: Black-and-white head-and-shoulders portrait of a uniformed officer wearing aviator-style wings and ribbon bar, mounted on a tan record sheet. Typed caption above reads "NEWHOUSE, Delbert Clement, LT 177283/1350 USN" with "14 JANUARY 1949" as the date of photograph and a blank signature line.
